tvs.bl1_about_service-title: Dreaming of clear, tattoo-free skin? Laser tattoo removal is the best option
tvs.bl1_about_service-text_1:
There is no more effective and proven method of removing eyebrow permanent makeup and tattoos than the laser. Whatever needs to go — eyebrow permanent makeup, microblading, lip micropigmentation or an old, faded tattoo; a worn-out tattoo or simply one you no longer like — in absolutely every case, permanent makeup and tattoos will be removed. And you won't feel any real discomfort: the procedure causes minimal pain. For high sensitivity, an anesthetic gel can be used when removing large tattoos
It all goes very easily! Just a few minutes once a month, and after only a few removal sessions you will have beautiful skin with a natural color, without a trace of pigment or ink.
tvs.bl1_about_service-text_3: The key to a successful procedure is the equipment. To remove the pigment, the PMU artist chooses the most suitable and effective removal option: the laser alone or, in complicated cases, a combination of the laser and remover. It depends on the age, color and intensity of the pigment. The removal methods can overlap and complement each other — but a positive result is guaranteed.
tvs.bl2_service_advantages-title: Benefits of laser tattoo and permanent makeup removal
tvs.bl3_service_equipment-notification: In most cases we use the neodymium laser. It is a powerful, professional, latest-generation device that removes tattoos and permanent makeup regardless of their depth. With the neodymium laser we successfully remove eyebrow, lip and eyelid permanent makeup as well as black-and-white and color tattoos, with the best possible results.

bl2_service_advantages-list.title: No burns, no scars, no marks.
bl2_service_advantages-list.text: Once healed, the skin is perfectly clean, without a single trace, and fully ready for new pigment if needed.

bl2_service_advantages-list.title: Safe for skin of any age
bl2_service_advantages-list.text: Laser removal of permanent makeup is safe for skin of any age. The procedure restores its natural color and tone, softness and elasticity.

bl2_service_advantages-list.title: No recovery period
bl2_service_advantages-list.text: The laser beam acts only on the pigment without harming the skin. No scabs, no scars and no lengthy healing. After the procedure, just 1–2 days of skin care are needed.

migx_questions.questions-title: How long does a laser tattoo removal course take in Bucharest?
migx_questions.questions-text: Laser removal is a course of several sessions. The procedure is done once a month. You can wait longer between sessions, but it is recommended not to do it more often than once every 30 days — otherwise the skin doesn't have time to recover, which can lead to scars and wounds. The number of sessions is set by the specialist after examining the tattoo and its reaction to the laser beam. It also depends on the size and color of the tattoo. On average, 6–8 sessions are needed.

migx_questions.questions-title: How many sessions does eyebrow permanent makeup removal take?
migx_questions.questions-text: The number of sessions depends on several factors: the result you want and the initial condition of the tattoo. If you want to lighten the pigment partially so it can be covered later, or to remove powder brows, 2–3 sessions will be enough. To remove an eyebrow tattoo completely, at least 4–6 sessions are needed.

migx_questions.questions-title: How much does tattoo removal cost?
migx_questions.questions-text: The cost of the course depends on the number of sessions and the size of the tattooed area. See the price list.

migx_questions.questions-title: Which is more effective for eyebrow permanent makeup: laser removal or a cover-up?
migx_questions.questions-text: It all depends on the initial condition of the eyebrow permanent makeup. Most often a cover-up won't help you change the color or shape, especially if the tattoo is old or has turned an unnatural shade. In that case a cover-up gives no result and makes your look less natural. Laser removal is the best solution if you want to remove eyebrow permanent makeup partially or completely. After the tattoo is removed, you can get new, beautiful permanent makeup. This can be the most effective option for a pretty, natural look.

migx_questions.questions-title: What are the specifics of laser removal?
migx_questions.questions-text: Laser removal uses a special laser device. It generates a beam that breaks the pigment down into particles, which are then eliminated naturally, without any discomfort. During the procedure you feel a slight tingling, but because it is so short, it is painless. Laser removal is considered the most advanced and effective procedure available today. No other alternative guarantees a similar result in terms of effect and safety.

migx_questions.questions-title: How is the procedure done, and does it hurt?
migx_questions.questions-text: Before the procedure, the PMU artist cleans the keratinized skin particles from the area where the tattoo will be removed. Then the procedure is performed; you are given protective glasses. Each session takes no more than 10–15 minutes, depending on the area of the tattoo being removed. At the end, the area may be treated with a regenerating, revitalizing cream, depending on how the skin reacts. Pain is minimal, because the beam acts only on the pigment and the skin doesn't heat up much during the session, so there is no real pain. However, if your skin is very sensitive, the specialist will use an anesthetic.

migx_questions.questions-title: How does the skin heal after the procedure?
migx_questions.questions-text: When the laser is used correctly and set up properly, no special aftercare is needed. It is recommended to protect the treated area from clothing friction and external factors as much as possible. Avoid steaming your skin and exposing it to ultraviolet light.

migx_questions.questions-title: How often should the procedure be done?
migx_questions.questions-text: No more than once a month — this is exactly the time the skin needs to heal and recover. If you prefer, you can remove the tattoo at longer intervals: once every 2 months or even less often. It is up to the client.

migx_questions.questions-title: Do I need to prepare for the procedure?
migx_questions.questions-text: The procedure requires no special preparation. Just avoid injuring your skin and sunbathing.

migx_questions.questions-title: When is laser removal not allowed?
migx_questions.questions-text: Laser removal is not recommended if there are wounds, acne or inflammation in the tattoo area. The procedure is contraindicated in diabetes, low blood clotting, while taking iron supplements or corticosteroids, or with varicose veins larger than 0.5 cm in diameter.
